If selected, data from incomplete submissions will also be included. This means:


• If a supplier provided partial CO2e data, the partial data will be displayed.

• If a supplier has not yet provided any data, an estimate would be made based on their most recent data submission in previous years.


Deselect to only include data from suppliers who have completed their data submission.
